WITH date_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
),
web_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
         df.d_date,
         SUM(SUM(ws_sales_price)) OVER (
           PARTITION BY ws_item_sk
           ORDER BY df.d_date
           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
         ) AS cume_sales
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN date_filtered df ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = df.d_date_sk
  WHERE ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, df.d_date
),
store_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
         df.d_date,
         SUM(SUM(ss_sales_price)) OVER (
           PARTITION BY ss_item_sk
           ORDER BY df.d_date
           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
         ) AS cume_sales
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_filtered df ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = df.d_date_sk
  WHERE ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, df.d_date
)
SELECT *
FROM (
  SELECT item_sk, d_date, web_sales, store_sales,
         MAX(web_sales) OVER (
           PARTITION BY item_sk
           ORDER BY d_date
           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
         ) AS web_cumulative,
         MAX(store_sales) OVER (
           PARTITION BY item_sk
           ORDER BY d_date
           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
         ) AS store_cumulative
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN web.item_sk IS NOT NULL THEN web.item_sk ELSE store.item_sk END AS item_sk,
           CASE WHEN web.d_date IS NOT NULL THEN web.d_date ELSE store.d_date END AS d_date,
           web.cume_sales AS web_sales,
           store.cume_sales AS store_sales
    FROM web_v1 web
    FULL OUTER JOIN store_v1 store
      ON web.item_sk = store.item_sk AND web.d_date = store.d_date
  ) x
) y
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
